skill_name: Explain why knowledge of robotics is important for future engineers.
workflow: Robotics is becoming increasingly important in engineering as automation and artificial intelligence become vital components of the work being done. With the growing prevalence of robots in manufacturing, healthcare and other industries, knowledge of robotics is essential in order to stay competitive in the industry.
